subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB637
title: Requires state agencies that administer programs to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the combustion of motor vehicle fuel to deposit fees, assessments or other charges imposed pursuant to the program in the State Highway Fund.
headline: SB 637 did not pass

claims.text: SB 637 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 637 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
